proof_attempt_summary: The D0 derivation established the residual-label orbit, sharp linear-query image, positive model attainment, and an exact binary-treatment monotonicity filter. D0.5 judged the package incremental because the design rule is a fixed-law oracle, its cost example is stipulated, and the note lacks feasible inference and external scientific support for exact invariance edges. A finite ordered-treatment extension is mathematically sound but was left outside this run under the operator's decision because hidden-tombstone retargeting in the persistence layer is unsafe.
tldr: On finite positive three-view models in the Allman--Matias--Rhodes Kruskal region, separated exact measurement-invariance edges and selected anchors determine a residual numerical-label orbit. Its image under any prespecified linear causal query is a finite assignment-cost set, with positive independent-noise SCMs attaining every branch. Binary-treatment outcome monotonicity has an exact finite stochastic-dominance branch filter. At a fixed compatible population law, the action-menu result gives a minimum-burden feasible query-identifying design; the fixed top-mastery example costs 6 versus 20 for per-context calibration.
gap: Local three-view decompositions identify components only up to permutation. Finite multigroup latent-class work formalizes partial and complete cross-group equality, Stoetzer--Zhou--Steenbergen impose a treatment-to-indicator exclusion restriction in parametric hIRT, and Fu--Green identify benchmark-scale average latent effects through nonparametric bridges. The inspected primary results do not characterize the residual numerical-outcome label orbit after sparse exact equalities, its sharp image for an arbitrary linear causal query, or a fixed-law population-oracle cost characterization for query-relevant actions.
fill: Prove evaluable edge and cycle certificates, anchor propagation, the exact residual marginal orbit, positive attainability within a stated independent-noise SCM class, the assignment-cost sharp-query iff, its mixed-difference and uniform specializations, and a fully typed population-oracle minimum-burden characterization. Demonstrate a strict, scientifically interpretable saving for a fixed sparse top-mastery design relative to per-context calibration.
